content: In the Mafāḥiṣ prologue as translated in the Prologue, Ibn Turka says that in his youth he sought a true education in the number sciences, travelling widely, until occult guidance brought him to Cairo with a group of friends, dearest among them his Brother in God Sharaf al-Dīn ʿAlī of Yazd, to meet the Sublime Sayyidic Threshold (Akhlāṭī).
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, K. al-Mafāḥiṣ, prologue (trans. Melvin-Koushki)
